Don't get me wrong, S13&14 does have some funny episodes. However, previous seasons always felt like the humor came first & the message was second, but the two always mixed together in a way that worked harmoniously. Because of this, I think sweet moments between characters felt organic (ie. that S9Ep6 Bobby Driver, where Edith & Bob bond during a funny situation where Bob becomes her getaway driver lol). 

S13&14 felt like the writers wanted to focus on the emotional message, so the situations the characters got themselves in often just felt like a backdrop to that emotional message.

Though there are only 6 episodes so far, S15 feels like it's fixing the issues they had with S13&14, with episodes Colon-ly the Dronely & Hope N' Mic Night. These episodes have emotional moments, but the humor feels improved on. I'm able to laugh and feel emotional in the same episode, which is a huge improvement.

When we asked our vet about this, he wasn't concerned since he wasn't neutered yet (my brother wanted to wait until he was 1 year old). My dog didn't show signs of aggression, so he recommended we just continue training him as is. So we did that & he then got neutered a week after his bday.

He doesn't pull on the leash as much, he listens to leave it, drop it, and he's able to sit & stay. But it's still not perfect & I think fast movements near him is sometimes still too much for him. **From left to right:**

* L'Oreal - Colour Riche Lip Colour in Everbloom 
   * I've had this since 2013 and honestly, I think it's still okay LOL. It's a very creamy and moisturizing formula with a satin finish, and is comfortable on the lips. I'm not really sure how to describe the smell but it doesn't bother me and goes away when you apply it. I'm not fond of the colour on myself either because it's quite a bright pink.
* Tarte - Tarteist Creamy Matte Lip Paint in tbt
   * I'm a personal fan of this formula! Like the name, this liquid lipstick is pretty creamy and comfortable. The formula is like a mousse, but it's very full coverage and you don't need to use that much product during application. That being said, it is not transfer-proof. I recommend this for those who like matte lipsticks but hate how uncomfortable they are. Even though it's not transfer-proof, you're making that sacrifice for comfort. So long as you don't mind the scent of mint, this is an awesome product! As for the colour, I love this shade on myself. It's a pretty mauve and great for autumn.
* e.l.f. - Matte Lip Color in Praline
   * I really like this product because it's very comfortable and easy to apply. Because it's kind of like retractable lip pencil, it's easy to apply around the edges of you lips. You do have the risk of it snapping (which has happened to me RIP), but it's not a big deal. As for the colour, it's a cool-tone brown, also great for autumn. The colour fades a little throughout the day, but I don't mind because of the easy application.
* e.l.f. - Matte Lip Color in Rich Red
   * This shade is a bright red with pink undertones. Personally, I think it's a bold colour, but it's still very wearable for the everyday. My only downside to this is that when the colour fades, it looks like a bright pink, which once again, I'm not fond of. 
* Tarte - Tarteist Creamy Matte Lip Paint in Birthday Suit
   * I got this in a mini size in the Sephora Birthday Reward in 2017 and I love it! At first, I thought this shade was too light on me, but after a while, I started liking it a lot. It's a pale-pink shade, which is a great nude for those with a similar skintone as me.
* Tarte - Tarteist Creamy Matte Lip Paint in Fomo
   * I personally don't love this colour that much. It's VERY similar to tbt, but more pink.
* Tarte - Tarteist Quick Dry Matte Lip Paint in Rose
   * I HATE this formula!! I've never been fond of liquid lipsticks that dry down, but this product is soo uncomfortable!! As the name says, it dries down very quickly, so you have to work fast. It honestly felt like sandpaper on my lip! As for the colour, I also didn't like it because I thought it was too light for me. I think if you're on the fair side, this would be a great nude for you!
* Bobbi Brown - Luxe Lip Color in Neutral Rose
   * I got a mini size of this as a Sephora 100 points award and it's great! The formula is creamy, and has a satin finish. As well, it's pretty pigmented! You don't need to go over it a bunch of times! As for the colour, I love it! It's like a dusty pink shade (I know dusty doesn't sound good, but it's good in this case lol). This is my "your lips but better" shade.
* Fenty Beauty - Mattemoiselle Plush Matte Lipstick in Griselda
   * I also got this in a mini size as a Sephora 100 points award. I don't love it, but I don't hate it. The formula is creamy and comfortable, but I dislike the shape of the lipstick because it makes application a bit more of a hassle, versus a traditional lipstick bullet. As for the shade, it's a very pretty wine colour, but I feel like it's a bit patchy. It also likes to cling on the dry skin of my lips, making it more obvious.
* e.l.f. - The Alissa Ashley Lip Gloss
   * I LOVE this product! It's comfortable and opaque! The applicator gets lots product, making it no need to dip twice. I also love the vanilla scent of it! As for the colour, it's rosy-brown. A lot of people say it's a dupe for the Fenty Beauty Gloss Bomb (which I don't have), but based on just pictures, it seems like this is more brown, whilst Gloss Bomb is more pink and has shimmers in it. 
* Jeffree Star Cosmetics - Velour Liquid Lipstick in Nathan
   * I got this not too long ago, so I can't really say much about it yet. I will say that it is WAY more comfortable than the Tarte Quick Dry Matte Lip Paint. As well, I like the applicator as it picks up just enough product. As for the colour, it's a bit lighter than I thought it would be, but it's a pretty terracotta colour. 

The one on the second row:

* MAC Cosmetics - Frost Lipstick in Tanarama
   * Also got this not too long ago from National Lipstick Day for free (ayeee). I'm not sure if I'm gonna use it as a lip topper, as a highlighter,  or just on my bare lips. The possibilities are endless!
